title: Lotus Crossing — Temple of the Evening Bell
description: A Japanese Buddhist temple at the moment of the evening bell. The broad double roof shelters interlocking timber brackets, glowing shoji and a gilded Buddha shrine. A bowed bridge crosses the lotus stream to the incense veranda. Beside a cloud pine and raked stone garden, a monk tends the suspended bell and its wooden striker. Finished verandas continue around the back.
